title: Code card
description: An editor window typing code with syntax colours: line numbers, the active line lit, a caret, indentation landing at once. After a beat the run strip slides open under the code with its result. For developer tools, APIs, SDK launches and 'it's one call' moments.

code.description: The code, lines separated by newlines (\n); at most 16 lines show.

language.description: How to colour it: ts (also JavaScript), python, shell or json.

filename.description: Name on the window's tab (empty: none).

output.description: Result shown in the run strip after typing (empty: no strip).
